get.description: List all workspaces in an organization.

parameters.name: organization_name
parameters.description: The name of the organization.

parameters.name: search[name]
parameters.description: Partial name to filter workspaces by name.

parameters.name: search[wildcard-name]
parameters.description: Wildcard name filter for workspaces.

parameters.name: filter[current-run][status]
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of run statuses to filter workspaces by.

parameters.name: filter[project][id]
parameters.description: Filter workspaces by project external ID.

parameters.name: search[tags]
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of up to 10 tag names that workspaces must have.

parameters.name: search[exclude-tags]
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of up to 10 tag names that workspaces must not have.

parameters.name: filter[tagged]
parameters.description: Filter workspaces by effective tag bindings. Example usage is `filter[tagged][0][key]=env&filter[tagged][0][value]=prod`.

parameters.name: filter[tag-union]
parameters.description: Use OR logic for filter[tagged] across effective tag bindings when any provided tag key/value pair may match. By default, filtering uses intersection semantics, so all provided tags must match.

parameters.name: filter[tag-value-default-null]
parameters.description: Treat omitted filter[tagged][value] fields as NULL for effective tag bindings.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort workspaces. Valid values include name, current-run.created-at. Prefix with a hyphen (e.g., -name) to sort in descending order.

parameters.name: fields[workspaces]
parameters.description: Return only the specified fields for workspaces resource(s) in the response. Use underscores for identifiers that contain a dash: For example, auto_apply instead of auto-apply. An empty value indicates that no fields should be returned.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Optionally side-load the specified relationships.

404.description: Organization not found or user unauthorized to view workspaces

status.description:
The current status of the run.

Terraform Policy evaluation status values at plan stage:
- `tf_policy_checked` - Terraform Policy evaluation completed
- `tf_policy_override` - Terraform Policy evaluation was overridden

stage.description: The run stage during which this task stage executes (e.g., post_plan, pre_plan, pre_apply, post_apply).

status-timestamps.description: A map of status names to timestamps indicating when the task stage entered each status. Keys are formatted as "{status}-at".

tf-policy-evaluations.description: Represents a Terraform Policy evaluation for a run. Coordinates the evaluation of multiple policy sets and aggregates their results. Each evaluation is associated with a specific stage (Init or Plan or Apply) in the run lifecycle.

status.description:
Current status of the Terraform policy evaluation. Status values:
- `pending`: Initial state, not yet queued for evaluation
- `queued`: Queued and waiting to be evaluated
- `running`: Actively being evaluated
- `awaiting_override`: Failed with overridable policies, awaiting manual override
- `passed`: All policies passed (final state)
- `failed`: Failed with mandatory policies (final state)
- `overridden`: Failed evaluation manually overridden (final state)
- `errored`: System error during processing (final state)
- `canceled`: Canceled before completion (final state)
- `unreachable`: Pseudo-state derived from run state

stage-type.description: The type of stage this evaluation is associated with.

status-timestamps.description: Timestamps for each status transition during the evaluation lifecycle

pending-at.description: When the evaluation entered pending status

queued-at.description: When the evaluation was queued for processing

awaiting-override-at.description: When the evaluation entered awaiting override status (for failed mandatory policies)

overridden-at.description: When a failed evaluation was overridden

errored-at.description: When the evaluation encountered an error

updated-at.description: When the evaluation was last updated

result-count.description: Aggregated counts of policy results across all policy sets in this evaluation

advisory-failed.description: Policies with advisory enforcement level that failed

mandatory-failed.description: Policies with mandatory enforcement level that failed

mandatory-overridable-failed.description: Policies with `mandatory_overridable` enforcement level that failed.

unknown.description: Policies with an unknown evaluation result

error.description: Error information if the entire evaluation failed (not policy-specific errors)

type.description: Error type identifier indicating the category of failure

detail.description: Detailed error message with additional context

archivist-supported.description:
Whether this evaluation supports archivist-backed outcome storage. When `true`,
full policy results are available via `policy-set-result-url` on each
`tf-policy-set-outcome`. When `false`, use the `outcomes` array instead.

can-override.description: Whether the current user has permission to override failed policies

is-overridable.description: Whether this evaluation can be overridden (based on policy enforcement levels and current status)

run.description: The run that this policy evaluation belongs to

tf-policy-set-outcomes.description: The Terraform policy set outcomes that are part of this evaluation

display-name.description: Human-readable display name for the user.

is-service-account.description: Indicates whether this user is a synthetic user representing a team or organization.

avatar-url.description: Gravatar URL for the user. Null in TFE when an admin has disabled Gravatar via the avatar_sources setting.

initials.description: TFE only. Backend-computed initials derived from the user's username, or email local part as a fallback. At most two characters. Returns "?" when neither is available.

avatar-color-index.description: TFE only. Stable index into the frontend avatar fallback colour palette, derived from the user's external ID. Colour uniqueness across users is not guaranteed.

preferred-language.description: The user's preferred language as a locale code (for example, "en" or "fr"). Must be one of the application's supported locales. Only returned for the current user.

can-view-admin-in-app-notifications.description:
Whether the user can view and author feature announcements in the admin UI. Present only for admins when site-admin RBAC is enabled.

This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

This attribute is considered BETA, is SUBJECT TO CHANGE, and may be unavailable to some users.

can-reenable-2fa-by-unlinking.description: This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

can-manage-hcp-accounts.description: This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

workspace-outputs.description:
Workspace outputs are Terraform output values associated with a workspace.
They include the name of the output and a sensitive boolean. There is an
additional attribute, "value", that can be any JSON type, including null when
the output is sensitive; it is intentionally omitted from this schema (same
pattern as state-version-outputs) because OpenAPI cannot express a nullable
any-type under the project's nullable-type-sibling lint rule.

output-type.description:
The Terraform type of the output value (e.g. string, number, bool,
list, map, set, object, tuple).

detailed-type.description:
A detailed representation of the output type. May be a string for
simple types or an array for complex types such as tuples and objects.

raw-markdown.description: Raw markdown contents of the workspace README.

source-module-id.description:
Identifier of the no-code module and version this workspace was created from
(for example, private/<org>/<name>/<provider>/<version>). Present only for
no-code workspaces; omitted otherwise. Prefer the no-code-module-version
relationship for a typed link to the current no-code module version.

no-code-upgrade-available.description:
Whether a newer no-code module version is available for this workspace.
Present only for no-code workspaces; omitted otherwise.

effective-state-version-retention-desc.description:
A human-readable description of the effective state-version
retention window for this workspace. Returns null when no state-version retention policy is in effect for the
workspace, or when the policy does not delete state versions.


This attribute is only available in Terraform Enterprise.

parent-data-retention-policy-info.description: This attribute is only available in Terraform Enterprise.

effective-run-data-retention-desc.description:
A human-readable description of the effective run data and logs
retention window for this workspace. Returns null when no run data retention policy is in effect for the
workspace, or when the policy does not delete run data and logs.


This attribute is only available in Terraform Enterprise.

hyok-enabled.description:
HCP Terraform Premium Tier only. Enabled Hold Your Own Key for the workspace. Once this has been set to true,
it can no longer be disabled.


This attribute is only available in HCP Terraform.

unarchived-workspace-change-requests-cou.description: This attribute is considered BETA, is SUBJECT TO CHANGE, and may be unavailable to some users.

oauth-client-name.description: The display name of the OAuth client associated with this workspace, if any.

no-code-module-version.description:
The no-code module version this workspace was created from. Present
only for no-code workspaces; data is null or omitted otherwise.
